{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
n_duplicates = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id values: {n_duplicates}')

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient_id
sample_seq_count = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Patients with multiple sample_seq: {sample_seq_count[sample_seq_count > 1].count()}')"}
